Spacious top-floor apartment in a house, ideal for families or larger groups. 

With five bedrooms and plenty of room to relax, it offers a comfortable and homely base in Tromsø. A bus stop is just a few meters away, making it easy to get around. 

The location is also a great choice for experiencing the northern lights when conditions are right.
